title: Checkout 5xx while the fault sits upstream in the order API
description: checkout-web returns 5xx and is what alerts. Its upstream order-api became anomalous three minutes earlier, after a configuration change reduced its database connection pool. The remediation therefore targets order-api, not the service that paged.

demand_responses.descriptor: configuration changes for the service in the 30 minutes before onset
historical peak traffic comparison at equal load
demand_responses.summary: checkout-web request rate is flat at 145 rps across the window and matches the preceding days
